name: flareid
description: A small, standalone OpenID Connect identity provider for Cloudflare Workers and D1
author: Simon Thorpe

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: A long random string, e.g. the output of `openssl rand -hex 32`. Keep it: you enter it on `/setup` to create the first administrator. It stops working once setup is complete.

KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts the token-signing keys FlareID generates and stores in D1. Generate it with `openssl rand -base64 48`. **Never change it later** - stored keys could no longer be decrypted.

DB.description: The D1 database holding the directory, clients, sessions, settings and audit log. Migrations run on every deploy.

SESSIONS_KV.description: KV namespace for short-lived sign-in state (login flows, pending second-factor challenges). Nothing in it needs to survive being lost.

METRICS.description: Analytics Engine dataset for per-request performance data, shown on the admin overview.

EMAIL.description: Cloudflare Email Sending, for password recovery, invitations and email codes. Works only once a sending domain is onboarded (`wrangler email sending enable`) and a From address is set in **Admin → Integrations → Email**.

ISSUER_URL.description: Leave empty: the issuer becomes the address you complete `/setup` on, and is then fixed. Add a custom domain **before** running setup, or set this (e.g. `https://idp.example.com`) to pin it.

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Optional: your account id, for the performance dashboard on the admin overview. Needs a `CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN` secret too (an API token with __Account Analytics: Read__).

APP_NAME.description: The product name shown on sign-in and admin pages. Can be changed later in **Admin → Branding**.
